verdict.rationale: Namecheap runs a dedicated sandbox API endpoint (api.sandbox.namecheap.com) that is separate from the production endpoint (api.namecheap.com). The sandbox answers live requests with the same API error format, so callers can test without touching production accounts or data. The evidence, however, is only raw endpoint responses rather than descriptive documentation. Missing for 10: docs on sandbox account signup and credentials, data isolation and parity with production, whether the Go SDK and Terraform provider can target the sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration.
